agent.problem: Too many choices depend on details the earlier cards have not supplied. Cards 2, 4, 10, 12, 15 and 18 ask about the invader's manner, Elam and Media, oiling shields, chariots and riders, horsemen in pairs and the threshing-floor picture without enough context to reason out those answers. Discovery questions therefore make up at least half of the stop, rather than only a few.

rule.text: Before each choice card, Papa Dorin's story card gives enough context that the baker can reason their way to the answer.
